newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude, product futures hold gains near close.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude, product futures hold gains near close.

text.p: NYMEX crude and oil product futures edged higher Thursday afternoon as a bounce from recent losses gained momentum on an outage at Tosco Corp's Bayway, New Jersey plant.

In fairly thin trding, January crude futures were holding well within Wednesday's wide range, hitting a high near the open of $23.82 a barrel and holding above a low $23.33. The contract was up 33 cents at $23.72.
"There was some crack spread short-covering," said Gerry Samuels, a trader at ARB Oil in California. That pared crude gains and helped lift products further.
